title: OpenAPI 3.1 CLI Vendor Extensions (x-cli-*)
description: Standardized x-cli-* extension fields for describing CLI binaries, subcommands, pipes, and exit codes inside valid OpenAPI 3.1 documents.

x-cli.description: Root-level CLI metadata placed at the top level of the OpenAPI document.

x-cli-position.description: Zero-based index for positional arguments (used on parameters with in: 'path').

x-cli-when-flag.description: Flag required to trigger this structured stdout format (e.g. '--json').

x-cli-exit-code.description: Process exit code corresponding to this OpenAPI response object.

x-cli-stream.description: Target file descriptor for the response payload.
